verses.en: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.sm: O OE foi le atalii o le tagata, ia vavalo atu l mauga o Isaraelu, ma e fai atu, Mauga o Isaraelu e, faalogologo mai ia i le afioga a Ieova.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are our's in possession:
verses.sm: Ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii o Ieova, Ua fai mai ia te outou le ua ita mai, Ue! ua fai mo i matou mea maualuga o le vavau;

verses.en: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:
verses.sm: o le mea lea ia e vavalo atu ai, ma e fai atu, Ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii o Ieova, Ua latou faatafunaina outou, ma naunau i le fia maua outou i itu uma, ina ia fai outou mo e o totoe o nuu ese, ma ua ta‘uta‘uina outou e tagata faitala, ma ua ta‘uleagaina e le nuu;

verses.en: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;
verses.sm: o le mea lava lea, mauga o Isaraelu e, ia outou faalogologo mai ai i le afioga a le Alii o Ieova, Ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii o Ieova i mauga, ma mauga iti, ma vaitafe, ma vanu, ma mea gaogao ua faatafunaina, ma aai ua tuufua, ua faoa, ma ua tauemua e i latou ua totoe o nuu ese i itu uma.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.
verses.sm: 0 le mea lea ua faapea ona fetalai mai ai o le Alii o Ieova, O le afi lava o lo‘u fuā ua ou fai atu ai i e ua totoe o nuu ese, atoa ma Etoma uma, o e ua avea lo‘u laueleele e fai mo latou, ma le fiafia o le loto atoa, ma le inoino o loto, ina ia faoa e fai ma vete.

verses.en: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:
verses.sm: 0 le mea lea ia e vavalo atu ai i le laueleele o Isaraelu, ma fai atu i mauga, ma mauga iti, ma vaitafe, ma vanu, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii o Ieova, Faauta, o lo‘u fuā ma lo‘u ita tele ua ou tautala atu ai; auā ua oo ia te outou le faamasiasiga o nuu ese.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua faapea ona fetalai mai ai o le Alii o Ieova, Ua ou sii lo‘u lima, ua faapea, O nuu ese o vagavagai ia te outou, e masiasi lava i latou.

verses.en: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.
verses.sm: A o outou mauga o Isaraelu e, e tutupu o outou la laau, e fua mai foi a outou fua mā lo‘u nuu o Isaraelu; auā ua latalata ona latou o mai.

verses.en: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:
verses.sm: Auā faauta, ou te i ai ia te outou, ou te faasaga atu foi ia te outou, ona galueaiina lea outou ma faatoaina.

verses.en: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:
verses.sm: Ou te faauluolaina foi tagata ia te outou, o le aiga uma o Isaraelu, o lona atoatoa lava; e āina foi aai, e atiina ae foi mea ua faatafunaina.

verses.en: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.sm: Ou te faauluolaina o tagata atoa ma manu ia te outou; e uluola lava i latou ma fananau; o a‘u e āinaina ai outou e pei o ona tuga tuai ia te outou, ou te agalelei foi ia te outou e sili i lo outou uluai āiina; ona outou iloa ai lea o a‘u lava o Ieova.

verses.en: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men.
verses.sm: Ou te faafeoaiina tagata i luga ia te outou, o lo‘u lava nuu o Isaraelu; e fai oe mo latou, e fai foi oe mo latou tofi, e te le toe faaumatia lava tagata ai ia te i latou.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they say unto you, Thou land devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations;
verses.sm: Ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii o Ieova, Ua latou faapea atu ia te outou, O oe ua e ‘ai tagata, ma ua e faaumatia tagata o ou nuu;

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.sm: o le mea lea e te le toe ‘ai tagata ai lava, e te le toe faaumatia foi tagata ai ou nuu, o loo fetalai mai ai le Alii o Ieova.

verses.en: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.sm: O a‘u foi e le toe lagona ai le faamasiasiga o nuu. ese, e le toe oo atu lava ia te oe le faaluma mai o tagata, e le toe faatausuaiina foi ou nuu, o loo fetalai mai ai le Alii o ieova.

verses.en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.sm: Ua oo mai foi le afioga a Ieova ia te au, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.
verses.sm: Le atalii e o le tagata, sa mau le aiga o Isaraelu i lo latou lava laueleele, ona leaga ai lea ia te i latou i a latou amio ma a latou mea na fai; sa tusa a latou amio i o‘u luma ma le leaga o le fafine ua nofo ese.

verses.en: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:
verses.sm: O le mea lea na ou sasaa ai lo‘u ita i luga ia te i latou, ona o le toto na latou faamaligiina i luga o le eleele, ona o a latou tupua foi na latou faaleagaina ai le nuu.

verses.en: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
verses.sm: Na ou faataapeape foi ia te i latou i nuu ese, ma faasalalauina i latou i nuu eseese; na ou faasala foi ia te i latou e tusa ma o latou ala, e tusa foi ma a latou mea na fai.

verses.en: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the LORD, and are gone forth out of his land.
verses.sm: Ua latou oo atu i nuu ese, na latou o i ai, ona ta‘uvaleina ai lea o lo‘u igoa paia ona o i latou, ina ua faapea ane ia te i latou, O le nuu lea o Ieova, ua latou o mai nai lona laueleele.

verses.en: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.
verses.sm: A e peitai na ou alofa ona o lo‘u igoa paia, o le na ta‘uvaleina e le aiga o Isaraelu i nuu ese na latou o i ai.

verses.en: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name's sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ia e fai atu ai i le aiga o Isaraelu, Ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii o Ieova, Ou te le faia lea mea ona o outou, le aiga o Isaraelu e, a o lo‘u igoa paia o le ua outou ta‘uvaleina i nuu ese ua outou o i ai.

verses.en: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am the LORD, saith the Lord GOD, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
verses.sm: Ou te faapaiaina lo‘u igoa mamalu ua ta‘uvaleina i nuu ese, o le ua ta‘uvaleina lava e outou i totonu ia te i latou; e iloa ai foi e nuu ese o a‘u lava o Ieova, o loo fetalai mai ai le Alii o Ieova, pe a ta‘upaiaina o a‘u ia te outou i o outou luma.

verses.en: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.
verses.sm: Auā ou te avea outou ai nuu ese, ma ou faapotopotoina outou mai nuu eseese uma, ma ou aumaia outou i lo outou laueleele.

verses.en: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
verses.sm: Ona ou sausauina lea o outou i le vai manino, ona mamā ai lea o outou; ou te faamamāina foi outou i lo outou leaga uma, ma a outou tupua uma.

verses.en: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
verses.sm: Ou te avatu foi ia te outou le loto fou, ma ou tuu i totonu ia te outou le agaga fou; ou te aveesea le loto maaa ai o outou tino, ma ou avatu ia te outou le loto aano.

verses.en: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.
verses.sm: Ou te tuuina atu lo‘u Agaga i totonu ia te outou, tou te savavali ai i a‘u tulafono, tou te anaana foi i a‘u faamasinoga, ma outou faia.

verses.en: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.sm: Tou te nonofo foi i le nuu na ou foaiina atu i o outou tamā; e fai foi outou mo‘u nuu, e fai foi a‘u mo outou Atua.

verses.en: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
verses.sm: Ou te faaolaina foi outou ai lo outou leaga uma; ou te valaau foi i le saito.ma ou faatuputeleina, a e ou te le tuu atu se oge ia te outou.

verses.en: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
verses.sm: Ou te faatuputeleina foi fua o laau, ma mea e tutupu i le eleele, ina ia le toe oo ia te outou le faaluma mai o nuu ese ona o le oge.

verses.en: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
verses.sm: Ona outou manatunatu ai lea i o outou lava ala leaga ma mea sa outou faia e le o i ai se lelei, tou te ‘ino‘ino ai lava outou ia te outou ona o a outou arnio leaga, atoa ma a outou mea e inosia.

verses.en: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord GOD, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.
verses.sm: O loo fetalai mai le Alii o Ieova, Ia iloa e outou ou te le faia ia mea ona o outou; ia outou mamā ma ia outou masiasi ona o outou ala, le aiga o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
verses.sm: Ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii o Ieova, O le aso ou te faamamāina ai outou i a outou amio leaga uma, o a‘u e āina ai a outou aai, e atiina ae foi mea ua faatafunaina.

verses.en: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
verses.sm: E galueaiina foi le laueleele sa faatafunaina, sa faatafunaina lava i luma o i latou uma e na ui ane ai.

verses.en: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.
verses.sm: Ona latou fai aue lea, O lenei laueleele sa faatafunaina, ua avea e pei o le faatoaga o Etena; o aai foi sa gaogao, ma faatafunaina, ma lepetia, ua nofo ‘olo i latou ua āina.

verses.en: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the LORD have spoken it, and I will do it.
verses.sm: Ona iloa ai lea e nuu ese o e totoe i o outou itu uma, o a‘u o ieova ua ou atiina ae mea sa lepetia, ma faatoaina le mea sa faatafunaina; o a‘u o Ieova ua ou fai atu ai, ou te faia lava.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii o ieova, E ui i lea, a e sailia mai pea o a‘u e le aiga o Isaraelu, ia faia ia mea mo i latou: ou te faatoateleina foi i latou e pei se lafu tagata.

verses.en: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.sm: E pei o le lafu paia, e pei o le lafu o Ierusalema i ona tausamiga, e faapea ona faatutumuina o aai gaogao i lafu tagata; latou te iloa ai o a‘u lava oIeova.
